content.text:
I'm identifying the separate shapes: a single isolated cell at (1,0), and a C-shaped block spanning rows 1-6 across columns 2-4. Checking how far the C-shape can shift left before it collides with the isolated cell in row 1.

So the C-shape shifts left by 1: row 1 becomes cols 1,2,3; the middle rows keep col 3; row 6 becomes cols 1,2,3.
